concerns.text: The plan never mentions the core data‑model entities (MoleculeGraph, PredictionResult, FeatureAttribution) defined in data-model.md, even though the pipeline creates and consumes these objects. This breaks the Plan ↔ Data‑Model consistency rule.

No contract from contracts/dataset.schema.yaml or contracts/output.schema.yaml is referenced or exercised in the plan. Each contract should be linked to at least one pipeline step (e.g., dataset validation against dataset.schema.yaml, output generation matching output.schema.yaml).
